name: LensVLM 9B

lineage.how_derived: fine-tuned with learned tools for selective context expansion

purpose: Long-context reading by visual text compression: scans compressed images of text (5x, 10x, 15x) and selectively expands only the relevant pages to their uncompressed form via learned tools (card; paper arXiv 2605.07019).

license.name: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (apple-amlr)
license.notes: LICENSE text read: licence limited to Research Purposes (non-commercial scientific research); commercial exploitation, product development and use in a commercial product or service are excluded; derivatives are research-only too; redistribution needs the agreement copy and attribution. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: dense/hybrid Qwen3.5 vision-language, 9B (config qwen3_5, hidden 4096, full attention every 4th layer)

pc-12gb.notes: 18.8 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 18.8 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.8 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 18.8 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 18.8 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: needs the custom tool-loop code from the Apple repo

tona_fit.reason: Interesting compressed-image-context idea for long contexts; the record holds no benchmark numbers and 9B is only marginal on 12 and 16 GB, so it is a technique to study rather than a worker.

open_questions: benchmark results (the card lists none; see the paper)
